messages:
alex: Quick sync — per-route KPI card proposal: include kernel-selection attribution + KV cache hit breakdown per-token. Need p50/p95/p99, throughput (rps & tokens/s), and error rate. Thoughts?

maria: yes pls add a small histogram for token-latency buckets. this helps explain p99

raj: +1. also want to see kernel fallback counts (fp16->int8 fallbacks) per-route. that's been a regression vector.

sylvia: can we surface which kernel was active for the request? maybe aggregated by time window.

alex: good point. telemetry events available: `kernel_choice`, `kv_hit`, `kv_miss`, `kernel_fallback`. we should derive attribution with `GROUP BY kernel_choice` and `percentile_cont(0.99)`.

maria: mock query:
```sql
SELECT route, kernel_choice, summary(p50)::float as p50, summary(p95)::float as p95, summary(p99)::float as p99, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_latency_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '1h'
GROUP BY route, kernel_choice
ORDER BY tokens desc
```

raj: for KV cache: include `kv_hit_rate = kv_hits/(kv_hits+kv_misses)` and avg latency when kv_miss. we saw p95 jump when kv_hit_rate < 0.6 for route `chat-compute`.

ops-bot: [alert] perf-regression-detected route=chat-compute window=2026-03-17T15:00Z drop in kv_hit_rate from 0.82 to 0.45 :warning:

alex: ran profiler on that window. gist: `kernel A` kept misrouting to `kernel B` due to heuristics; fallback to slower kernel + cold KV miss amplification.

raj: can we add a per-route smallcard that shows: current p50/p95/p99, kv_hit_rate, kernel_fallback_rate, tokens/s, error_rate? and a sparkline for last 30m.

maria: yes — UX note: keep card width narrow. show p95 bold, p99 red if > threshold. click opens drill-down with token-level waterfall.

alex: wrote a rough panel spec:
```json
{"type":"kpi","metrics":["p50_latency","p95_latency","p99_latency","kv_hit_rate","kernel_fallback_rate","tokens_per_sec","error_rate"],"group_by":"route","time_window":"30m"}
```

sylvia: drop-in to sync 10 minutes? i'll bring the profiling flamegraphs and kernel selection logs.

alex: dropping figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/per-route-kpi-cards (mock)

maria: tiny nit — ensure sampling preserves tail tokens for p99. don't downsample uniformly.

raj: agree. prefer reservoir sampling keyed by route+kernel.

deploy-bot: dashboard patch v0.2 deployed to staging.

alex: thanks. next steps: (1) telemetry mapping PR (2) dashboard panel PR (3) run A/B to ensure no perf cost from extra telemetry.

sylvia: I'll add profiling notes to the PR.

maria: :thumbsup:
